name: An Unfinished Thought
thesis: A personal letter in plum-black ink, where expressive serif writing and machines in the margins reveal the engineer behind the work.
interaction: Lift SERV0’s panels from its margin annotation, then follow the letter into the machines and the people behind them.
why: Intimate first-person writing, a cat-avatar signature, and off-axis machine annotations make this feel like Raygen’s own publication rather than a portfolio template.
